channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nate Bjorkgren | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nate Bjorkgren from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Pritchard on #Pacers having to move on from Bjorkgren:

“It's my fault. It's our organization's fault. We've got to do better.”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren, Jun 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Pritchard on Bjorkgren:

“Nate beat himself up today as much as any coach I've ever seen. He took it pretty hard. ... I consider him a friend and I want to help him as much as I can.”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren, Jun 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren
item.description:
Kevin Pritchard on moving on from Nate Bjorkgren:

“This was my decision.“If healthy, I think we can compete with any of those (top) teams. Once you get into that area — assume health, assume the team comes together — I think we’re a tough out.”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren, Jun 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren
item.description:
Pritchard on what #Pacers players said about Bjorkgren:

“In the exit meetings, no one said they they were unhappy. Yes, they said he micromanages.... Nate had to find his identity... He's our coach as of now.... I'm not committing either way (to whether or not he comes back).”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:#Pacers president Kevin Pritchard on Bjorkgren:

“That position in the NBA is the most challenging position that there is.... There was some good things Nate did this year but there was some things we need to do better, he needs to do better. Right now, no decisions have been made”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren
item.description:
#Pacers president Kevin Pritchard on Bjorkgren:

“We probably did 15 interviews around Nate. We knew that he's very specific in the way he likes things. We knew that. You got to give a coach some flexibility to do what he likes to do.”

Kevin Pritchard on Nate Bjorkgren, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Doug McDermott on Nate Bjorkgren
item.description:
McDermott on Bjorkgren:

“Its' a challenging year to be a head coach anywhere. I have a lot of respect for that guy.... There's a lot of stuff wrote about him that I don't agree with. .... Indiana is really lucky to have him.”

Doug McDermott on Nate Bjorkgren, May 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Nate Bjorkgren
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Brogdon on getting familiar with Bjorkgren:

“I heard he's a mastermind behind the scenes who developed a lot of what Toronto does. .... We're in need of creativity.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Nate Bjorkgren, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.
